## Factory change

- [ ] Scope is bound to an active controller dispatch and lease.
- [ ] No author reviewed or approved their own work.
- [ ] Evidence identifies producer identity, task, lease, source commit, and artifact digest.
- [ ] Registry and preflight checks pass.
- [ ] Protected control paths were not modified outside an approved governance change.
- [ ] Rollback is deterministic and does not require AI judgment.
